blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 102 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (October 28, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: HLF & CRL lead 102 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 31 Canadian and 71 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of October 28, 2026) found 102 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 31 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 11 of them new to the list this week. High Liner Foods Incorporated (HLF) leads with a +96% six-month return, and Energy is the most represented sector with 16 names.

In the U.S., 71 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 27 of them new to the list this week. Charles River Laboratories International Inc. (CRL) leads with a +125% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 24 names.
